_about: Tracker v3 airline fact definitions (p5): the 42 facts of the frozen airline rule set. Merged by the main chat on 2026-10-23 from output/eval_v3/p5_parts/airline_a.json (23 facts: booking, modification) and airline_b.json (19 facts: cancellation, compensation). Expressions are written in p6-p8. Part A: Tracker v3 p5, airline part A: definitions of the 23 booking and modification facts (the other 19, cancellation and compensation, are part B). Each fact is two-valued (true / false), false until its update rule makes it true, set from its sources: database (the copy at the check), event (a tool call that worked), arguments (the pending call), structure (code on the text), question (one tiny saved yes/no question, K1-K15). Written from the airline policy (sentence ids of from_shieldagent/rules/airline/rule_set.json) and tau-bench's airline tool code; not from the judge's answers, the gold scorer or the rule set's predicate descriptions. `expr` stays null: p6, p7 and p8 write the expressions. `rules` and `blocking_value` equal output/eval_v3/rule_table_airline.json. Notes: output/eval_v3/p5_parts/airline_a_notes.md. | Part B: Tracker v3, part 5, airline part B: the definitions of 19 airline facts (cancellation, transfer, compensation). Each fact is a two-valued state with parts (database, event, arguments, structure, question; an optional part-level who overrides the fact's who), a combine rule, a start value (false) and an update rule. Written from the policy text (from_shieldagent/policies/airline_wiki.txt; sentence ids from the frozen rule set), not from the judge's answers, the gold scorer or the rule set's predicate descriptions. expr stays null: p6 (database, event, arguments), p7 (structure) and p8 (questions) write them. rules and blocking_value equal output/eval_v3/rule_table_airline.json. The shared fixed readings use part A's wording. Notes: output/eval_v3/p5_parts/airline_b_notes.md. The main chat merges this with part A into state_tracker/v3/facts_v3_airline.json.

A method named only in a negative way ('not the visa', 'I don't have a gift card or credit card', a mention joined by 'or' / 'nor' to a negative one) is not named.
